## Great Elm Capital Corp. (“GECC”) Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


10/30/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 110 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/780206090/files/doc_news/Great-Elm-Capital-Corp--GECC-Schedules-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-and-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


Conference Call Scheduled for Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET


PALM BEACH GARDENS, Fla., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Great Elm Capital Corp. (the “Company” or “GECC”) (NASDAQ: GECC), a business development company, today announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the close of market trading on Monday, November 2, 2026. The results will be discussed in a conference call on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET.


Date/Time: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 – 8:30 a.m. ET


Participant Dial-In Numbers:


(United States): (877) 407-0789


(International): (201) 689-8562


To access the call, please dial-in approximately five minutes before the start time and, when asked, provide the operator with passcode “GECC”. An accompanying slide presentation will be available in pdf format via the “Events and Presentations” section of Great Elm Capital Corp.’s website[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bxdINOB_whxII-1VkBy9sHGqcrs0HmipptqGLLxxIkZ0_88-bsWZ2_kBAIMcfm0BMBJLoeZafvStR--O88BwMHLW3k5lFYv-0B5mHyKw05Sa8mUeXaxZZPiegOXhfdoWip3Y60DyBOTAgt7IK93p7w==) after the issuance of the earnings release.


**Webcast**


The call and presentation will also be simultaneously webcast over the internet via the “Events and Presentations” section of GECC’s website or by clicking on the webcast link[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bxdINOB_whxII-1VkBy9sHVj3iAx9Apeq8hN78OoH9Q8LAynqT16Cd71au7x8J36qv43Dd2ZDq9z62q9e2bLNdwc-guJGV4Ffiyn2cYjHIYMyrA7Zk2XQAmJNsVIiaGCPS8o4iZlnwqNKiajENStjA==) .


**About Great Elm Capital Corp.**


GECC is an externally managed business development company that seeks to generate current income and capital appreciation by investing in debt and income generating equity securities, including investments in specialty finance businesses and CLOs. For additional information, please visit[http://www.greatelmcc.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=J5fOkdaZ-JU3imHwjJxajt__aIMxOuYqafcMTw1jeJ90q8l5ig8TAzfjf3csTnEvObPFAT3E5MKrkhhzZpQE1LMTbc-TrCyvXTOFCjjY3CCsnEoQTXL2MZhRQmZfdzi9dUr4Q7_hJ7mDe6tFrezqaw1LPEdJc1tMLcAxB5EgaMUvu0bHN6cBEA93wAs3gz0Ih7nC-iGPOWXWcRuWs9rFDF3jNDvdxA8sdwHjoxZmFZqKF-JU13AV1nPpP3kE5biyrAp3FsgbVxgMr2l2i9X9uQ==) .
